message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts: drunk driving (driving under influence) with blood alcohol 97.477 mg/100ml (i.e., 0.097% BAC). Under Chinese criminal law, drunk driving causing dangerous driving is a crime: "危险驾驶罪" (dangerous driving). Specifically, Article 133 of Criminal Law: "在道路上驾驶机动车有下列情形之一，构成危险驾驶罪: (1) 酒后驾驶机动车的; (2) 超速行驶; (3) 竞驶、追逐比赛; (4) 其他严重危及公共安全的行为". So drunk driving is dangerous driving. Also, if prior conviction and within probation period, committing new crime may lead to "累犯" (repeat offense) which may increase penalty. But the crime remains dangerous driving. Also possibly "酒后驾驶" is an administrative offense, but criminal is dangerous driving. So answer: [罪名]危险驾驶<eoa>. If also consider "酒后驾驶" as separate? In Chinese law, the criminal offense is "危险驾驶罪". So single.
